summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony by analysing the confidential supply data, building a general recheck-and-act agent product (Lighthouse) with a polished UI and demo, and preparing for office hours and the 12:45 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's all-ok launch plan hides real Collector's Edition shortfalls (overbooked art books, failed statue lot, etc.), built a poller/extractor/verifier/approval app with case flow, routines, alerts and logo, merged teammates' branch, and exposed a no-login demo at lighthouse.stenglein.dev with a saved story state. Many commits on main remain unpushed and live is not restarted as the hand-in nears.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no webhooks; the only way to detect drops is polling the file list and comparing SHA-256, since files are replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ and .env; .env.example is committed. Entire only checkpoints when repo files change, so read-only sessions skip checkpoints.

Routine steps are kind-specific: 'Chase once if no answer' only works on routines watching messages awaiting an answer, 'Ask for a status' only on shipment routines. Server rejects others with 'step N cannot be done on <kind>'; the Add step menu now greys them out with the reason.
The API does not load .env on import, so settings like ASK_VIEWER_TITLE need a helper that loads .env first, and a restart before live shows them.

Demo instance is run via scripts/demo.sh (restart, save-story, story) with ASK_DEMO_OPEN=on and ASK_DEMO_HOST; it runs locally in tmux behind a Cloudflare tunnel, with caffeinate to prevent sleep. Restarting the tunnel takes all hosts down for about a minute.
Case flow and routine diagram share connector and node components exported from FlowGraph.tsx so the styles cannot drift.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist in the repo; claim tasks via a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md.
Number keys 1-9 only choose an option, while Cmd+Enter executes the selected one; the '1' badge now shows only when other options are open.

code.finding: Bell now opens a menu (send test alert, turn off on this device) when alerts are enabled; backed by a new alerts-off endpoint in src/ask_soony/push.py and helpers in web/src/lib/push.ts.

workflow: Use a subagent for bulk cross-checking (200 order confirmations vs 59 scans) and for logo variant design; it keeps the main context clean.
Verify UI changes with headless screenshots at phone and desktop widths, and measure pixel positions rather than guessing alignment.
When the user interrupts a tool call, commits may already have gone through; check git state before reporting.
Confirm before outward-facing actions (push, opening the demo without login) and keep confidential data out of the repo and external services.

friction: Hooks seemed not to fire, but Entire simply skipped the checkpoint because no repo files had changed.
Case-flow layout needed many iterations (two-column snake, then single column, then compact/full) and the user found phone layouts empty, crowded or auto-scrolling.
Logo nudge went the wrong direction first and needed pixel measurement to fix.
Restarting the Cloudflare tunnel via tmux failed once and took all hosts down for about a minute.
The demo state had drifted (only 5 cases open, art books and rev B sleeves gone) and needed a reset to snapshot before recording.
Hand-in time moved from 12:00 to 12:45, while main grew to 30+ commits ahead of origin and was never pushed.
Adding 'chase once' on a decision routine looked broken because the menu offered an invalid step.
open_items: Push main (about 30 commits ahead of origin) and restart live (:8000) so sign-in choice, Senior Buyer title and heartbeat appear.
Record the demo video and prepare the deck (user to do the recording and voice-over).
Send the real Karton Nowak art-book order within its 24h window and answer Boise about EXW; needs a registered sender address and inbox.
Ask Lio engineers whether portal data is identical across teams and whether supplier replies create portal files.
Support 'send email, then chase once if no reply' on decision routines.
Redesign Routines page into a compact list with details on demand, duplicate detection and a ⋯ menu.
Consider a bottom-sheet case list on phones, and a small preview image inside the case flow.
Delete or keep the old Claude Doc artifact; update the briefing page with the 14:37 drop.
Consider moving the demo to ada if it must run without the laptop; the user's portal password is in Discord history and should be changed after the hack.
